svg.text: NgarumaVTC · Schneidlade für den Lernkasten A7 · Karton t = 4 mm
Bolti M10 × 140, washa 2, nati ya kufunga
Countersunk bolts M6 × 35, wing nuts, washers
Bolti M6 × 35 za kichwa bapa, nati za mabawa, washa
Steel pins Ø 3 × 20 (cut nails) as blade stop
Pini za chuma Ø 3 × 20 (misumari iliyokatwa) za kusimamisha
Skrubu za mbao 4 × 40, 4 × 25; gundi ya mbao
Viwembe vya kuvunja 18 mm (vinaletwa kutoka Ujerumani)
All sizes in mm. The dimensions L × W × T are finished sizes. Plane the rail R and the fence A perfectly straight: the cut is only as straight as the rail.
Vipimo vyote kwa mm. L × W × T ni vipimo vya mwisho. Randa reli R na kizuizi A viwe vinyoofu kabisa: mkato ni mnyoofu kama reli ilivyo.
Alle Maße in mm, Fertigmaße L × B × D. Schiene R und Anschlagleiste A ganz gerade abrichten: Der Schnitt wird nur so gerade wie die Schiene.
